milestone.title: post-cutover autopilot internal cleanup — rename watch modules/tests and remove dead orchestration paths

intent.outcome: After canonical autopilot certification, the implementation has one internally named autopilot stack while the legacy CLI alias remains a thin compatibility adapter.

problem.description: M208 intentionally retains watch module names during migration. Leaving the old names and unreachable two-role prompt/state paths indefinitely would obscure ownership and invite fixes to dead code.

in_scope: Rename crates/mp/src/watch to autopilot and update internal imports after M226 certification.
Rename canonical integration tests and fixtures to autopilot names while retaining focused watch-alias compatibility tests.
Remove unreachable legacy lifecycle prompt stages, orphan coordinator drive state, obsolete bridge wake-up paths, and superseded template/runtime code proven unused.
out_of_scope: Removing the mp watch CLI alias, legacy persisted-state reader, legacy config fallback, or public compatibility JSON fields.
Changing certified behavior or adding new autopilot features.

acceptance_criteria.description: Canonical production implementation and non-compatibility tests use autopilot module/type names; remaining watch-named code is isolated under documented compatibility adapters.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test watch_cli --no-fail-fast exit 0 (23/23 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Unreachable legacy prompt stages, orphan coordinator-only state, superseded bridge wake-up code, and dead template runtime paths are removed only after coverage proves the M207-M226 replacements.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: cargo nextest run -p mp --test autopilot_drive_execution --no-fail-fast exit 0 (83/83 pass)

acceptance_criteria.description: Full mp and raul test suites plus consumer-surface lint pass with no behavior or JSON-shape regression.
acceptance_criteria.evidence: NEXTTEST=1 make test exit 2 — 5607 tests run: 5604 passed (1 leaky), 3 failed, 1 skipped. 3 pre-existing failures verified at c2ebe69 baseline in a separate worktree (no M228 diff): mp autopilot::migrate::tests::idempotent_re_run_is_a_no_op (topology orchestrator missing), mp::scenarios_runner run_implemented_scenarios (env-dependent golden drift), mp-oracle::mini_schema_parity parity_real_schemas_compile_and_reject_empty (autopilot-session.schema.json missing from oracle list). Signal flake fixed in M228 commit 4875225.

design_decisions.choice: Rename canonical internals and remove proven-dead paths while retaining all executable/public compatibility shims in isolated adapters until M229.
design_decisions.rationale: This removes maintenance ambiguity without shortening the promised migration window.

findings.description:
AC-03 (NEXTTEST=1 make test) shows 3 pre-existing failures that are NOT M228 regressions. They were independently verified at c2ebe69 (the previous milestone's merge commit) by this reviewer in a separate worktree without the M228 diff:

1. mp autopilot::migrate::tests::idempotent_re_run_is_a_no_op — fails with: called Result::unwrap() on an Err value: MigratedSessionInvalid("/topology: orchestrator is a required property"). The test (renamed only; logic unchanged) writes a legacy WatchState with a Runner pane but no Coordinator pane, then expects the migrated session to expose an orchestrator topology. Build_session_from_legacy never sets the orchestrator field. Reachable: c2ebe69 same error (exit 100).

2. mp::scenarios_runner run_implemented_scenarios — fails with: walkthrough-execution-check: stdout mismatch. Expected golden has 6 watch_readiness checks; actual has 8 (extra runner_role_resolved + orchestrator_role_resolved, plus harness_auto_set message gains the [opencode, cursor, pi] list when multiple harnesses are installed). Environment-dependent: the diff is purely from the local harness set. Reachable: c2ebe69 same error (exit 100).

3. mp-oracle::mini_schema_parity parity_real_schemas_compile_and_reject_empty — fails with: assertion left == right failed. Left (on disk) = [annotation, autopilot-session, brief, challenge, idea, milestone, plan, spec-domain, track]. Right (ACTIVE_SCHEMA_FILENAMES) = same list without autopilot-session.schema.json. The schema file was added (M208 era) but the constant in crates/mp/src/schema.rs was never updated. Reachable: c2ebe69 same error (exit 100).

M228 scope explicitly excludes bug-fix work ("Changing certified behavior or adding new autopilot features" is out-of-scope). These are pre-existing bugs the runner already flagged as dogfood candidates. File as backlog so they survive M228 lifecycle complete.

Note: 2 additional bridge tests (run_herdr_with_timeout_returns_output_on_fast_child, run_herdr_with_timeout_kills_entire_process_group) appeared red in this reviewer's cold-cache run but are documented pre-existing flakes (M151/M152/M206/M217 reviews + mp-dogfood-log.md line 1264). At HEAD: 1/9 and 2/8 isolation-fail respectively. At c2ebe69: 0/5 and 1/5. Not M228 regressions; not in the runner's S3 evidence (runner reported 5604/5607 because flakes happened to land green for that run). No separate finding — pre-existing, well-tracked.
